verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a wallet and payments platform, but the pack documents no export of account, order or wallet data in open formats. Three items are only adjacent: the "Switch providers without migrations" line, non-custodial wallet ownership, and webhooks that fire on "signer exports". None of them is a documented capability to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
